sources.scope: ACS manual printed p51/PDF p53 identifies distillation heating to dryness as a hazard. Separate teacher-approved salt recovery is an instructional repair, not a method specified by ACS.
Official compiled NaCl solubility values support only the qualitative modest temperature dependence. No precision model or high cooling yield is asserted.
Primary crystallisation research documents impurity incorporation, adhering material and trapped mother liquor. Purity is not guaranteed by a fixed recrystallisation count.

sources.scope: Eriksson et al. 1995 direct human separate-enantiomer/racemate dosing study reports rapid thalidomide R/S interconversion.
Official evaluation guidance: assess individual activity, toxicity, disposition and interconversion; a single isomer can be more toxic than its racemate.
IUPAC optical rotatory power defines concentration/path-length normalization; zero-signal nonuniqueness follows from the measurement model and stated missing information.
NIST original optical-rotation reference report documents wavelength, temperature, calibration and uncertainty controls.
Primary chiral-crystallisation measurement combines polarimetry with concentration/impurity data and specified optical conditions.

IUPAC chirality: non-superimposability on a mirror image is the definition; a tetrahedral carbon stereocentre is one common example. Official indexed definition checked; direct page returned HTTP 403, with no bypass.

sources.scope: Original Lipinski author abstract gives strictly greater-than risk thresholds (500 mass, calculated logP5, donors5, acceptors10). Boundary values do not exceed them; heuristic does not prove efficacy.
OECD authored method distinguishes equilibrium concentration ratio from its base-ten logarithm. Neutral-species partitioning and pH conditions matter.
IUPAC distribution ratio includes analytical concentration across forms and depends on conditions, including pH.
Official codeine label describes mu-opioid agonist activity of weaker affinity than morphine and CYP2D6 morphine formation. No dose, substitution or prescribing recommendation follows.
FDA research report supports transdermal delivery avoiding initial gastrointestinal/portal first-pass exposure.
Official transdermal product label documents subsequent metabolism and hepatic elimination contribution; used only to disprove bypassing liver forever.
Official extended-release oral product label demonstrates that controlled release is not exclusive to patches. No product recommendation is made.
FDA 2019 draft, nonbinding and not final, identifies formulation/release/permeation and in-vivo performance considerations. Not presented as current binding regulatory requirements.
